sections.title: Export a full container
sections.content:
**Main steps of the "Export a full container" process in the system:**

1. Create the order

2. Confirm the order

3. Create the waybill (container)

4. Confirm the waybill (container)

5. Create the dispatch order for the vehicle and driver

6. Confirm the dispatch order

7. The driver accepts the dispatch order

8. The driver performs the tasks

9. The dispatcher checks the container and seal numbers after the driver completes the "Pick up empty container" task

10. The dispatch order is completed

11. The waybill (container) is completed

12. The order (booking) is completed

13. The dispatcher updates the container transfer plan
